entities.name: Muhammad 'Alauddin Al-Aththar Al-Bukhary Al-Khawarizmy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sayyid Alauddin Attar was a Sufi Saint from Bukhara and Shaykh of the Naqshbandi Sufi order. He was a descendant of Muhammad and son in law of his master and predecessor Khwaja Bahauddin Naqshband.
